text_block_list.text:
Tickezo's been aiming for the Japanese
Derby all
along, right?
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Not just Tickezo—Taishin and Hayahide
are too!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Ahh! I guess we can expect a pretty hot

showdown then!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
At some point during the Twinkle Series,
the
three friends started being referred
to as "BNW."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Many fans have shown up at the
Japanese Derby
just to see the famous
trio in action.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Amid the excitement, Ticket is on
standby in the
waiting room, when she
suddenly looks up at me
with a serious
expression.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hey, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Do you think I can inspire people just
like the
Umamusume I saw back then?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Will they be cheering for me? Will they
get
pumped up when they see me run?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
She can't stop fidgeting, so I show her
the
broadcast of Tokyo Racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At last, the Japanese Derby is about to
kick off.
The track is packed to the brim
with fans!
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
The camera pans up to show the eagerly
waiting
audience. Many fans are holding
large signs and
banners to show their
support, and among them
is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh! That one says "Good luck, Tickezo!"
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
It's a huge banner, and it's just for
Winning
Ticket.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Heeey! You got this, Tickezo!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
What passionate cheers! I'm sure
Уиннинг Тикит
must be thrilled to hear
them!
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text: Yeah, I am! I hear you, everybody!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
As Ticket stares intently at the screen,
tears begin
to well up in her eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sob... Sniff... I'm so glad! Everyone's really hyped!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: Show them all your passion for the Derby!

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I'll do my best! More than my best!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: FOR THE DEEERRRBYYYY!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
As if to match her enthusiasm, a big
wave of
cheers can be heard on the
broadcast right at
that moment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Finally, the gates open and the Derby
begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
